# job of a type is filled, from the vanilla base output.

# Country scope. pe_va_<firm>: value added of the variant at stage 1, fully staffed
# (entertainment is added per planet). pe_val_<firm>: the same with diminishing value for
# repeated shares (1 / 0.9 / 0.8 / 0.7) and -5% per existing firm with the same main
# product (at least half), used to choose. Also pe_dval_<rural> = value of a rural state
# district.
pe_compute_values = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_dval_m value = pe_vaj_pe_private_miner }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_dval_m value = 2 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_dval_e value = pe_vaj_pe_private_technician }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_dval_e value = 2 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_dval_f value = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_dval_f value = 2 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_aaac value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_aaac value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_metallurgist }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_aaac value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_metallurgist }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.35 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_aaac value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_artisan }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_aaac value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_artisan }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_aaac value = pe_tmp }

	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_cnt_f }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = -0.05 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_tmp value < 0.5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffc value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_ffft value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_ffft value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_ffft value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.35 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_ffft value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_trader }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_ffft value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_trader }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_ffft value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_cnt_f }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = -0.05 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_tmp value < 0.5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_ffft value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_fffm value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffm value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1.5 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_fffm value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer }

	change_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffm value = pe_tmp }

	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_tmp value < 0.5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffm value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_va_d_pe_firm_fffe value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffe value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_farmer }

# Colony scope: planet-specific values in root variables. pe_dval_u = value of one state
# city district on this planet (from its zones). pe_ent_val = value of one
# entertainer job here (amenity shortage), pe_spec_<letter> = 1.6 for shares that match the
# planet's designation, 0.8 for the other shares on such a specialised planet, else 1.
pe_planet_prepare = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_b value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 0.3 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = 0 }
	}
	# Value of one state city district here: one job per zone (100 workforce each).
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_foundry value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_metallurgist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_factory value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_artisan } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_industrial value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_metallurgist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_artisan } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_trade value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_trader } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.3333 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_physics value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_society value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_engineering value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_research_unity value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_physicist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.1667 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_biologist } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.1667 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_engineer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.1667 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_bureaucrat } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_unity value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_bureaucrat } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_unity_spiritualist value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_bureaucrat } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_unity_bio_trophy value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_bureaucrat } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { num_zones = { type = zone_resort_entertainment value > 0 } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_vaj_pe_private_entertainer } multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 } change_variable = { which = pe_dval_u value = pe_tmp } } }
	if = { limit = { free_amenities < 0 } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 30 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { free_amenities < 1000 } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ent_val value = 8 } } }
	# A specialised planet: all shares 0.8 first, the matching ones 1.6.
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_foundry has_designation = col_capital_foundry has_designation = col_factory has_designation = col_capital_factory has_designation = col_city has_designation = col_capital_trade has_designation = col_resort has_designation = col_pleasure has_designation = col_research has_designation = col_bureau has_designation = col_bureau_spiritualist has_designation = col_mining has_designation = col_capital_extraction has_designation = col_generator has_designation = col_farming } }
		root = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_b value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 0.8 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 0.8 }
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_foundry has_designation = col_capital_foundry } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_a value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_industrial has_designation = col_factory has_designation = col_capital_factory } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_c value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_city has_designation = col_capital_trade } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_t value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_resort has_designation = col_pleasure } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_u value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_x value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_y value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_research } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_z value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_bureau has_designation = col_bureau_spiritualist } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_b value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_mining has_designation = col_capital_extraction } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_m value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_generator } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_e value = 1.6 } } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { has_designation = col_farming } } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_spec_f value = 1.6 } } }
}

# Deposit scope: recognise a firm that was placed without variables (e.g. console).
pe_firm_identify = {
	if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaac } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaac_2 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaac_3 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaat } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaat_2 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaat_3 } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { is_deposit_type = d_pe_firm_aaau } set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } }

# this planet), its class (1 city, 2 mining, 3 generator, 4 farming, 5 lab), and its

pe_deposit_fetch_scale = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
	change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wf_miner value = pe_tmp }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wf_technician value = pe_tmp }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wf_farmer value = pe_tmp }
}

# Colony scope: root.pe_best_variant = most valuable variant available here, above
# root.pe_best_min (0 = none). Planet designation, entertainment need and a random
# factor (0.8-1.2, entrepreneurial spirit) count.
pe_choose_variant = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_best value = pe_best_min }
		set_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 0 }
	}
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aaac CODE = 1 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aaat CODE = 2 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aaau CODE = 3 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0.5 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aacc CODE = 4 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aact CODE = 5 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0 PRIM = a DCLS = u }
	pe_consider_variant = { V = d_pe_firm_aacu CODE = 6 MODE = $MODE$ ENT = 0.5 PRIM = a DCLS = u }

# Colony scope: buy a state district. Human empires on Free Market get an offer (one per
# quarter); AI empires and Laissez-faire buy directly.
pe_buy_or_offer = {
	if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 1 } } } 
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { is_ai = no has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_offer_pending } check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= 240 } }
			}
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 360 }
			save_event_target_as = pe_offer_planet
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_variant value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_class value = 1 }
				set_timed_country_flag = { flag = pe_offer_pending days = 3600 }
				country_event = { id = pe.110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner = { OR = { is_ai = yes has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } } }
			pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aaac CODE = 1 DISTRICT = district_city SITE = d_pe_site_city MONTHS = 8 MINERALS = 500 TRADE = 100 PRICE = 600 }
		}

# Colony scope, monthly: a finished construction site becomes its firm.
pe_site_complete = {
	root = { set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 0 } }
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_sites check_variable = { which = pe_left value <= 0 } }
		root = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_target }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_tstage }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_debt value = prev.pe_debt }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_kind }
		}
		remove_deposit = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 } } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaac last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aaac days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } else = { owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_found_d_pe_firm_aaac days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaac_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aaac_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 3 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaac_3 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aaac_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaat last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_retool_d_pe_firm_aaat days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } else = { owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_found_d_pe_firm_aaat days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

# Colony scope: carry out the stage change one firm asked for in its accounts
# (1 expand, 2 shrink, 3 bankrupt). The firm keeps its capital.
pe_firm_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 1 } } }
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 0 } }
		random_deposit = {
			limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms check_variable = { which = pe_pending value > 0 } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_pending }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_code }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_stage }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_debt value = prev.pe_debt }
			}
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_pend_any value = 0 } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = 1 } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_firm_aaac_2 last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_up_d_pe_firm_aaac_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_bankrupt_d_pe_firm_aaac days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } } }

}

# Colony scope: the state buys back the least valuable firm at the buyout price x stage
# (if it can pay) and rebuilds the district. The investors get the price plus the firm's
# capital minus its remaining debt.
pe_nationalise_one = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = 100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 0 }
	}
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_val value < root.pe_worst } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = prev.pe_val }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 500 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 100 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -500 trade = -100 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 600 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 750 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 150 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -750 trade = -150 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 900 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 1000 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 200 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -1000 trade = -200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 1200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }

		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }

		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 1 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 300 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 60 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -300 trade = -60 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 360 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 450 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 90 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 600 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 120 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -600 trade = -120 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 720 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }

			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -450 trade = -90 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 540 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }

			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -500 trade = -100 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 600 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }

		}
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 2 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 750 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 150 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -750 trade = -150 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 900 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }

		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 3 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 1000 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 200 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -1000 trade = -200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 1200 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } }
			remove_deposit = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value > 0 } } }
		set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 180 }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } } } add_district = district_city }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } } } add_district = district_mining }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } } } add_district = district_generator }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } } } add_district = district_farming }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } } } add_district = district_city }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 2 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_2_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 3 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_3_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 4 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_4_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 1 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_1 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 2 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_2 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 5 } check_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 3 } } } owner = { create_message = { type = pe_private_economy localization = pe_msg_nat_1_3 days = 30 target = event_target:pe_msg_planet variable = { type = name localization = PLANET scope = event_target:pe_msg_planet } } } }
		check_planet_employment = yes
	}
}

# Colony scope: the debt-free firm with the largest gain switches to the best variant
# available here (any class, same stage) if that is clearly better (+30% of its value, at
# least +3 trade per month). It closes for half the build time (a construction site), and
# the planet pauses restructuring for two years. Cost: city 250 / rural 150 x stage size, paid
# from the firm's own capital only (never on credit). A rural target needs a free district of
# its type once the old firm is gone; if there is none, the old firm is restored, the
# cost paid back, and that rural type is not tried again on this planet for a year.
pe_restructure = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rollback value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_paid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_val_all value = -100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_cls_var_all value = 0 }
	}
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aaac CODE = 1 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aaat CODE = 2 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aaau CODE = 3 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aacc CODE = 4 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aact CODE = 5 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aacu CODE = 6 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aatt CODE = 7 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aatu CODE = 8 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_aauu CODE = 9 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ccca CODE = 10 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ccat CODE = 11 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ccau CODE = 12 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ttac CODE = 13 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_actu CODE = 14 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uuac CODE = 15 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ttta CODE = 16 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ttau CODE = 17 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uuat CODE = 18 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uuua CODE = 19 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ccct CODE = 20 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_cccu CODE = 21 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_cctt CODE = 22 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_cctu CODE = 23 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ccuu CODE = 24 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_tttc CODE = 25 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ttcu CODE = 26 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uuct CODE = 27 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uuuc CODE = 28 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_tttu CODE = 29 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ttuu CODE = 30 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_uuut CODE = 31 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxxy CODE = 32 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxxz CODE = 33 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxxb CODE = 34 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxyy CODE = 35 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxyz CODE = 36 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxyb CODE = 37 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxzz CODE = 38 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxzb CODE = 39 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xxbb CODE = 40 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyyx CODE = 41 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyxz CODE = 42 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyxb CODE = 43 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzxy CODE = 44 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_xyzb CODE = 45 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_bbxy CODE = 46 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzzx CODE = 47 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzxb CODE = 48 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_bbxz CODE = 49 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_bbbx CODE = 50 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyyz CODE = 51 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyyb CODE = 52 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyzz CODE = 53 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yyzb CODE = 54 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_yybb CODE = 55 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzzy CODE = 56 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzyb CODE = 57 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_bbyz CODE = 58 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_bbby CODE = 59 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzzb CODE = 60 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_zzbb CODE = 61 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_bbbz CODE = 62 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmmm CODE = 63 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmma CODE = 64 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmmc CODE = 65 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmmt CODE = 66 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmme CODE = 67 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_mmmf CODE = 68 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eeee CODE = 69 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eeea CODE = 70 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eeec CODE = 71 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eeet CODE = 72 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eeem CODE = 73 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_eeef CODE = 74 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ffff CODE = 75 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fffa CODE = 76 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fffc CODE = 77 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_ffft CODE = 78 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fffm CODE = 79 }
	pe_retool_consider = { V = d_pe_firm_fffe CODE = 80 }
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_all }
		subtract_variable = { which = pe_gain value = pe_val }
		# Clearly better: at least 30% of the current value, and at least 3.
		set_variable = { which = pe_thr value = pe_val }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_thr value < 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = pe_debt value <= 0 }
				check_variable = { which = pe_gain value > pe_thr }
				check_variable = { which = pe_gain value > root.pe_best_gain }
			}
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = prev.pe_gain }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 250 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 250 } }
		else = { set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 150 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_stage }
		change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 0.5 }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_cost value = pe_tmp }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_fcap value >= pe_cost } }
			subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = pe_cost }
